nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: Which impurities are found in the electrolyte of the SPL according to the paragraph?
nodes.answer: The electrolyte impurities mainly contain fluorides: Na3AIF6, NaF, CaF2, and Al2O3.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Water purification techniques|Electrodialysis methods_qna_001
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What components are included in the electrolysis cells during the production process?
nodes.answer: The electrolysis cells are filled with a portion of aluminum metal and a cryolite-based electrolyte.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Water purification techniques|Electrodialysis methods_qna_002
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What is the typical operating temperature range for the electrolysis cells in aluminum production?
nodes.answer: The typical operating temperature range for the electrolysis cells is 940°C to 960°C.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Water purification techniques|Electrodialysis methods_qna_003
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What significant discovery did Potter make in 1911 related to electricity production?
nodes.answer: Potter discovered that adding a platinum electrode to a liquid suspension of yeast and Escherichia coli allowed the bacteria to produce electricity.
